caption: A spotlight follows a remote-controlled car across a dark stage, and the circle of light moves with it.

sa.check: A remote-controlled car crosses a stage.
The circle of light moves with the car.

pc.expect: The lit circle stays centred on the car and the rest of the stage stays dark.
pc.fail: The circle lags or leads the car; or the whole stage is lit; or the circle is elsewhere.

pc.expect: The circle moves only as the car and spotlight move.
pc.fail: It moves with the car stopped; or it jumps; or it stays put while the car drives.

pc.expect: The car's shadow falls on the floor away from the spotlight.
pc.fail: The shadow points toward the spotlight; or there is no shadow in the beam; or shadows fall in several directions under one light.

pc.expect: The circle is one round patch with a soft edge.
pc.fail: It splits; or is a sharp square; or it floods the stage.

pc.expect: One car and one circle of light.
pc.fail: A second car appears; or two circles under one spotlight; or the light becomes solid.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The car and the stage stay the same.
pc.fail: The car changes colour; or the stage changes; or the light changes colour.

note: Illumination: the on/off causality of electric lights belongs to Electricity; here only where the light goes once it exists is judged.
